name: browser
description: Operate web pages in a dedicated, visible Chrome profile on the member's machine: the agent reads each page and acts on its controls, as a desktop, phone or tablet shows them, and can turn a run into an animated GIF guide; the component pauses before anything irreversible, for a sign-in only the person can do, and before leaving the site. No credentials to set: the room is the credential (each call acts as the person the agent is answering, in their own browser).

settings.label: Browser executable
settings.help: Leave empty to use the first installed of Google Chrome, Chromium, Microsoft Edge or Brave.

settings.label: Browser profile directory
settings.help: Where the agent's browser keeps its sign-ins. Leave empty for bnbloc's own profile; never point it at your everyday browser's profile.
